question: What time does the café open on Saturdays?
reference_answer: 08:00 (open 08:00 to 17:00 on Saturdays).

question: What are the café's opening hours on Sunday?
reference_answer: 09:00 to 16:00, from 1 March 2026 (the January 2026 memo changed it from 09:00 to 15:00).

question: What discount do staff get?
reference_answer: 25% off food and drink when not on shift, from 1 February 2026 (up from 20%). Retail coffee beans and gift cards are excluded.

question: Can I bring a friend and get the staff discount for them too?
reference_answer: No. The guest discount was discontinued from 1 February 2026.

question: When is the rota published?
reference_answer: Every Wednesday by 17:00, for the following week (changed from Thursday by 15:00 from 1 February 2026).

question: How much sick pay do I get?
reference_answer: The first 5 sick days in each leave year are paid at 100% of normal daily pay with no daily cap (from 1 February 2026; previously 70% up to €110). Further sick days are unpaid.

question: How many days of annual leave does a full-time employee get after 4 years of service?
reference_answer: 22 days (3 to 5 years of service).

question: Can I carry over unused holidays to next year?
reference_answer: Yes, up to 5 unused days, but they must be used by 31 March or they are lost.

question: Can I take annual leave on 20 December?
reference_answer: No. Leave cannot be taken from 1 to 24 December.

question: What breaks do I get on a 7-hour shift?
reference_answer: A 15-minute paid break plus a 30-minute unpaid lunch break.

question: How do I let the manager know I'm sick?
reference_answer: Phone the café manager at least 2 hours before your shift starts; a text message is not enough.
anchor: A text message is not enough

question: When do I need a doctor's note for being off sick?
reference_answer: For any absence of more than 2 consecutive days (a medical certificate).

question: How much compassionate leave do I get if my grandmother dies?
reference_answer: 1 day of paid leave (a grandparent is not immediate family; immediate family gets up to 3 days).

question: When are tips paid out?
reference_answer: Tips are pooled and shared monthly by hours worked, and paid with salary in the second pay of the following month.
anchor: second pay of the following month

question: How much notice do I have to give if I resign after my probation?
reference_answer: 2 weeks.

question: How is overtime paid?
reference_answer: Hours above 39 in a week are paid at 1.25 times the normal hourly rate, and overtime must be agreed in advance with the café manager.

question: What temperature should the fridges be?
reference_answer: Between 0°C and 5°C.

question: The fridge is showing 7°C. What should I do?
reference_answer: Check the door is closed and re-check after 30 minutes; if still above 5°C, move the food to another fridge and tell the café manager. High-risk food above 8°C for more than 2 hours must be thrown away and recorded.

question: Is our oat milk gluten free?
reference_answer: No. It is not certified gluten-free; customers with coeliac disease should be offered soya milk or another certified gluten-free option.

question: How long can opened oat milk be kept?
reference_answer: Use within 5 days of opening.

question: I had a stomach bug with vomiting yesterday. When can I come back to work?
reference_answer: Only after being free of symptoms for 48 hours; tell the café manager before your shift.

question: What temperature must reheated food reach?
reference_answer: A core temperature of at least 75°C, checked with the probe; food can only be reheated once.

question: A Leinster Dairy delivery arrives at 9°C. Should I accept it?
reference_answer: No. Chilled deliveries above 8°C must be rejected. Note it on the delivery note, report it to the supplier the same day and ask for a credit note.

question: As café manager, can I approve a €2,800 coffee bean order from Bean & Leaf?
reference_answer: Yes. Since 1 February 2026 the café manager can approve orders up to €3,000 (previously €2,500), and Bean & Leaf is an approved supplier.

question: By when do I need to order coffee beans for a Thursday delivery?
reference_answer: By Tuesday 12:00, from Bean & Leaf Importers Ltd.

question: A supplier emailed asking us to send payments to a new bank account. What should I do?
reference_answer: Do not change the bank details because of an email; phone the supplier on the number we already hold to confirm the change first (it is a common fraud).

question: When are supplier invoices paid?
reference_answer: By bank transfer in the weekly payment run every Wednesday, on or before their due date.

question: What is our espresso recipe?
reference_answer: 18 g of ground coffee in, 36 g of espresso out, in 27 to 32 seconds.

question: My espresso shots are running in 22 seconds. What should I change?
reference_answer: Adjust the grinder one step finer (shots faster than 27 seconds are too fast).

question: The espresso machine is leaking on a Saturday. What should I do, and when will an engineer come?
reference_answer: Switch the machine off at the wall, put down a wet floor sign and phone Eireann Espresso Services on 01 555 0199 quoting contract ESS-2291. At weekends the engineer comes the next working day.

question: How often is the espresso machine's water filter changed?
reference_answer: Every 3 months or after 5,000 litres, whichever comes first (done during the quarterly service).
